content: mypy incremental adoption on existing codebase: official docs recommend enabling flags progressively (check_untyped_defs, disallow_incomplete_defs, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores, strict_equality first; disallow_untyped_defs last as hardest). Per-module [[tool.mypy.overrides]] lets you set disallow_untyped_defs=true globally with narrow legacy exceptions, or the reverse (loose default, strict allowlist for ready modules). Avoid global ignore_errors.
